name: native-static
description: Inspect PE, Mach-O, or ELF files without executing an untrusted binary.
instructions: Record hash, format, architecture, sections, imports, strings, and available hardening metadata using read-only inspection. Separate suspicious indicators from vulnerabilities and avoid asserting exploitability from strings alone. Do not run the binary, attach a debugger, or install it. Preserve exact command event IDs for each claim; propose a safe follow-up in an appropriate isolated environment when dynamic behavior is required.
